messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] hyperprior Half Cauchy with scale parameter 25
parts:
You can use either 'table:' or 'expression:', see

inla.doc("table:")


this is the example for precision ~ Gamma(a,b). you need to change the
below, and add the Cauchy prior, or what the prior is for the precision
is std.dev is cauchy.

I think Cauchy is a waaaaay to heavy tailed and exponential on std.dev
is more sensible, which is the pc prior for precision, use
prior="pc.prec". just my opinion



prior.function = function(log_precision) {
a = 1;
b = 0.1;
precision = exp(log_precision);
## CHANGE HERE
logdens = log(b^a) - lgamma(a) + (a-1)*log_precision - b*precision;
## END OF CHANGE HERE
log_jacobian = log_precision;
return(logdens + log_jacobian)
}

lprec = seq(-10, 10, len=1000)
prior.table = paste(c("table:", cbind(lprec, prior.function(lprec))),sep
= "", collapse = " ")
n = 100
y = rnorm(n)

r = inla(y~1,
data = data.frame(y),
control.family = list(
hyper = list(
prec = list(
prior = prior.table))))
